command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '=== ID ===
'; whoami; hostname; date -Is
printf '
=== HOME TOP ===
'; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*frank*' -o -iname '*crush*' -o -iname '*.desktop' \) -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200
printf '
=== DESKTOP FILES ===
'; for d in "$HOME/Desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications"; do [ -d "$d" ] && find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.desktop' -print -exec sh -c 'echo --- $1; sed -n "1,220p" "$1"' _ {} \;; done
printf '
=== PROCESSES ===
'; ps -ef | grep -Ei 'crush|frank|charm|entityos|terminal' | grep -v grep || true
printf '
=== REPOS ===
'; for d in "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/frank-repo" "$HOME/clay" "$HOME/.local/share/free-frank"; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then echo --- $d; git -C "$d" status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done
printf '
=== SHELL/APP CONFIG HITS ===
'; grep -RIlE 'Free Frank|Charm.*CRUSH|chatgpt-senden|gpt-oss-120b|frankenstein-repo' "$HOME/.local/share/applications" "$HOME/.config" "$HOME" 2>/dev/null | head -200 || true
